description: He wears an opaque muted burgundy-purple long coat with narrow gold geometric woven borders at the opening, cuffs and hem. A cream long-sleeved tunic with a gold-trimmed split neckline lies beneath. A matching purple and gold woven belt with a round decorated gold buckle wraps the waist, with short fringed tails below. Brown trousers and tall dark brown leather boots remain fully visible. Fabric appears substantial and softly textured; exact fiber is uncertain. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
